name: protein tyrosine phosphatase receptor type T

function.text: PTPRT encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase T. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
